title: Tiny Toon Adventures - Scary Dreams
sources: own knowledge of the game (written in our own words)

widgets.text:
Health; lives
Buster Bunny's side-scrolling adventure through scary dreams; a few hits cost a life

Jump, dash, attack
Jump on enemies or use Buster's dash; some areas need a running jump to cross

Dream bosses
Each dream ends with a boss; Montana Max's pranks drive the story between levels

Dream levels
Themed dream levels (sports, haunted and others), played in order

Carrots
Carrots are the collectible pickups; extra lives are hidden along the way

Hidden items
Look above the main path for hidden carrots and lives

Levels cleared
Levels cleared in order to wake up from the last dream
